<div class="card-body">
'''Come With Me''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">行くぞ、ついて来い</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、宇宙戦闘機の専属パイロットを除外する試みを行う。運命数を引く。運命数＞2なら、宇宙戦闘機に配備して専属パイロットを除外する。パイロットを1名乗せられるようになる。戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使用するためには、パイロットが乗っていなければならない。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Come-With-Me-PSA-159081594.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">さまざまな戦術上の理由から、パイロットの選定は出撃の直前になって行われることが多い。ダース・ベイダーはDS-61-2とDS-61-3を従えてヤヴィンの戦いに挑んだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Let's go, follow me.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to attempt to remove a starfighter's permanent pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on the starfighter and remove the permanent pilot. It may now add 1 pilot. Power, maneuver, and hyperspeed may not be used unless a pilot is aboard. This Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
For various tactical reasons, pilot selection is often made just before launch. Darth Vader took DS-61-2 and DS-61-3 with him to the Battle of Yavin.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 行くぞ、ついて来い (let's go, follow me).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Come With Me]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
